question: A student attempts to measure the internal resistance $r$ of a cell (EMF $\varepsilon$) using a potentiometer. The cell is shunted by a resistance $R$. The balancing length is found to be $l$. The experiment is then repeated after replacing the potentiometer wire with another wire of the same material and length but **half the radius**. In the repeated experiment, the current through the potentiometer wire is kept the same as before (by adjusting the rheostat in the primary circuit). What will be the new balancing length $l'$?
